the characterization of the DNA-binding properties and protein—protein interaction of the DnaD protein, which is important for the understanding of the DnaA/PriA-directed replication primosomes.

the molecular mechanism of the DnaD protein and the primosome assembly.

the DnaD protein plays a role in the assembly of a functional replication primosome, which is required for the recruitment of the replicative helicases.

the C-terminal of SaDnaA is crucial for its DNA and PriA binding, but not its DnaA binding and self-oligomerization, which is consistent with the results from our previous study.

The main takeaway from our work is that
DnaD plays a key role in the assembly of the primosome and the initiation of DNA replication by binding ssDNA and Pri helicase.
DnaD plays a role in the recruitment of PriA helicases to the ssDNA, which is the key step in the initiation of replication in bacteria.
